feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: DOJ brings criminal charges against former FBI Director James Comey for third time
entry.summary: The Justice Department has brought criminal charges against former FBI Director James Comey for the third time.

entry.title: Judge rules that the DOJ illegally fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey
entry.summary: A federal judge ruled the Justice Department unlawfully fired former prosecutor Maurene Comey, the daughter of ex-FBI Director James Comey. The case adds to concerns of politically motivated firings.

entry.title: Trump travels to Mississippi to campaign before the midterms
entry.summary: President Trump is travelling to Mississippi to campaign before the midterms. The state's U.S. Senate race has seen millions of dollars in last-minute spending.

entry.title: The Trump administration is taking on fraud ahead of the midterm elections
entry.summary: Vice President J.D. Vance has made tackling fraud a signature policy goal — and a way to distinguish himself from the administration. But will it address voters' concerns about government corruption?

entry.title: Tens of thousands of Israeli expats expected to fly home to vote in critical election
entry.summary: Tens of thousands of Israeli citizens living abroad have flown to Israel to vote in person in Tuesday's election. NPR's Ruth Sherlock reports from the airport.

entry.title: U.S. military forges ahead on autonomous weaponry
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has announced initiatives to speed the adoption of drones and AI across the military. Meanwhile, Congress is considered at least some safeguards for autonomous systems.

entry.title: Walter Koenig, who played Chekov in the original Star Trek series, has died at 90
entry.summary: The actor who played the Russian navigator, Pavel Chekov, on the original Star Trek series and a number of movies that followed has died. Walter Koenig was 90.

entry.title: Violent anti-government protests rock Albania
entry.summary: Violent protests in Albania are escalating, as demonstrators demanding the prime minister's resignation accuse his government of corruption and call for change.

entry.title: Former national security adviser breaks down new U.S.-Iran threats
entry.summary: President Trump has been threatening attacks on Iran after the midterms. Meanwhile, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton sent a memo warning of ramped up Iranian attacks on U.S. citizens.

entry.title: How Lula defied the odds to win Brazil's presidency
entry.summary: Against the odds, Lula has staged a stunning political comeback — but winning Brazil's presidency may prove easier than governing a deeply divided nation.
